text: {"user":"I’m looking for a fun weekend activity that’s not too expensive. Can you give me a simple plan for Saturday afternoon in my city?","plus_response":"Absolutely. If you share your city and whether you want something more active or more relaxing, I can tailor it precisely—but as a default, you can do: (1) pick one local landmark/park for a 60–75 minute walk, (2) add a short museum/garden stop nearby for another 60 minutes, and (3) end with a timed reservation or event ticket so you’re not scrambling.
